newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel rise, other metals quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel rise, other metals quiet.

text.p: Indian copper and nickel prices extended gains on Friday while other base metals were unchanged, dealers said.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 11,750 rupees while nickel gained by 200 rupees to 38,000 rupees on increased buying by the stainless steel industry for approaching festivals.
"Arrivals were low and sentiment was firm," one dealer said.
Tin, zinc and lead were unchanged.
Aluminium was steady at 7,250 rupees on nominal trading but sentiment was weak on reports of sliding global prices.
